results.title: Agent loop duplication
results.evidence: Separate entrypoints: Agent.run (rooks-code/agent.py:253) vs assistant.run_turn (workbench/backend/app/assistant.py:828). Both executed with scripted model, distinct call stacks.

results.title: Tool coverage asymmetry
results.evidence: Terminal 14 tools (read_file, edit_file, run_command, start_background, check_background, stop_background, task, todo, web_search, web_fetch, list_files, search, write_file, remember). Web 65 tools. Registries dynamically inspected from actual Agent.tool_specs() and available_tools().

results.title: Diff review missing on browser/app
results.evidence: Assistant.tsx renders tool calls as name+args only (lines 273, 290-294). No diff preview component for pre-apply review. Code.tsx DiffView is for CLI agent run diffs on Code page, not for Assistant chat tool calls.

results.title: Terminal parallelism gap
results.evidence: Two start_background jobs launched via registered tool; measured overlap 2.47s (sleep 4s each). Exit codes [0,0]. task tool executed real nested sub-agent with read-only registry (5 tools offered). Extras.subagent synchronously calls sub.run.

results.title: Cross-surface session continuity
results.evidence: Learning.after posted two terminal turns via TestClient to /v1/rooks/turn → same conversation_id=3, persisted in SQLite, visible via authenticated /api/conversations lookup. Session ID propagated as external_id.

results.title: Anomaly-first layout
results.evidence: Dashboard approvals above fold: 0. Assistant approvals above fold: 0. Fixed header with approvals: false. Approvals rendered in chat stream (Assistant.tsx line 298), not in fixed header above fold.

results.title: App missing terminal
results.evidence: Desktop Tauri registry has no interactive terminal command; Rust sources have zero openpty/forkpty/portable.pty tokens. Backend plan_signin.py spawns real PTY via pty.openpty/Popen for credential discovery (exercised, works). No desktop UI command exists for general interactive shell.

results.title: Screen reader accessibility
results.evidence: axe-core on Assistant page: 2 violations (missing main landmark, missing h1). No ARIA live regions for approvals/steps. Terminal: not tested with VoiceOver/Orca harness; prompt_toolkit/Rich ARIA not verified.
